what.text: This page follows refugees from Kenya in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13325 refugees from Kenya.
Ethiopia hosts the largest share, 42.3%, followed by Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Northeastern Province and Coast territory in Kenya with Al-Shabaab from 2015 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 1997 and 2007 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1975 at 90 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
